name: Cancellation by Host
beschreibung: Did your host cancel your booking at the last minute, leaving you without a place to stay? We'll help you claim a full refund and, if applicable, compensation for the extra cost of a replacement hotel.

name: Mold, Dirt & Pests
beschreibung: Mold in the bathroom, roaches in the kitchen, or just plain dirty bedding? You don't have to put up with hygiene issues like these. Document everything for your AirCover reimbursement.

name: False Listings & Fake Photos
beschreibung: Did the "luxury villa" turn out to be a basement apartment, or were the listing photos completely outdated? If the property doesn't match the description, you're entitled to a significant price reduction.

name: Missing Amenities (Wi-Fi, Pool, A/C)
beschreibung: No Wi-Fi despite your work-from-home plans, or the advertised pool turned out green and unusable? Missing amenities that were promised in the listing entitle you to a reduced rental price.

name: Security Deposit Wrongfully Withheld
beschreibung: Is the host claiming damages after checkout that you didn't cause, and withholding your deposit? Fight back against unjustified claims and get your money back.

name: AirCover Claim Denied
beschreibung: Did Airbnb close your case or deny your refund even though the problem was obvious? Turn up the pressure with an official legal letter to the legal department.

name: General Airbnb Issue
beschreibung: Don't see your specific issue listed above? No problem. Use this general form to file a legally sound complaint about any Airbnb issue.
